pages.text: One of the applications of a Blood Feather is in the creation of a Tesseract. This frame exhibits anomalous gravitational properties, making it so not only can people safely fall onto it - without any pain - but it can also be placed midair without any support. Powering it with a Redstone signal will cause it to deactivate and fall like Sand.
It can be made with four Feathers, a pair of Gold Ingots, a Phantom Membrane, some Redstone and a Blood Feather.
